neighborhood_overview:
Ciutadella
The historic city of Ciutadella in located at the extreme west coast of Menorca. It used to be the
capital of culture and commerce in Menorca, and although it has not been this for a long while, it is still a very attractive city, with a wonderful heritage and real appeal.

History
Nicknamed Vella I Bella, which translates to the Old and Beautiful, the city was first settled by the
Carthaginians, and since early days has been in competition with Mahon. In 1558 the city was evaded by 15,000 strong Turkish troops and was defended by just a handful of men. The city fell and was devastated, most of the survivors were
taken back to Turkey and sold as slaves.

When the British arrived in 1708 the city ceased to be its capital.

About town
Ciutadella is a very attractive city, with a charming port, and old quarter, which is a delight to explore. There are several good examples of Baroque and Gothic churches in the city.

name: A rural retreat in Menorca
description: A restored Grade 1 listed house on the outskirts of the town of Alaior.  A 10min walk into the village, ideal for the early bird that wishes to surprise the family with fresh bread & newspapers at breakfast   And only a 15min drive to Binigaus beach!
neighborhood_overview: The quiet and extremely authentic town of Alaior is a short 10 minute walk away.  The town offers a great range of shops and supermarkets. host_about:
My wife and I have been visiting Menorca for the last 8 years.  We immediately fell in love with the unspoilt nature of the island and searched for our rural retreat for 3 years. We stumbled across this wonderful yet derelict property and were immediately drawn to its convenient location, quiet rural setting, heritage status and Mediterranean landscape.

We are both involved with property restoration professionally in the UK.  As a chartered landscape architect I am treating this a very personal challenge.  This is our Mediterranean 'landscape laboratory' where we are seeking to develop wonderful gardens to suit the outdoor living that our young family loves when on holiday.  

We have restored this very special piece of Menorcan heritage to the highest architectural standards.   We have equipped the house with all mod-cons and with highest quality furnishings.  This has been a very personal and exquisite restoration which we hope you will enjoy as much as we do.

neighborhood_overview:
Pou Nou is the heart of the map, a place that conveys calm but also a certain contained tension.

Around it, the reddish dirt roads open in several directions, delimited by dry stone walls that draw straight and curved lines at the same time, as if the terrain were an open labyrinth. The vegetation is typical of the Menorcan countryside: fig trees, almond trees, and bushes that cast short shadows and barely offer coverage.

What characterizes Pou Nou is the feeling of a crossroads. From here you can access different routes: some more open and faster, ideal for moving forward; others narrower and winding, which invite exploration and surprise.

The atmosphere is quiet, but never completely safe. The sound of the wind through the leaves and the birdsong accompany the steps, reminding us that this is a place of transit... and that the real adventures start here.

Island of Minorca, the pearl of the Balearic Islands!

In fact, Son Bou is located in the center of the island overlooking the south, which is the most popular tourist part.
The apartments are located at Torre Soli Nou, which is definitely the best spot on the beach.
The beach of Son Bou is one of the most beautiful on the island, 3 km of fine sand and crystal clear waters. The sandy bottom is also ideal for children. However, I would recommend renting a car, in order to be able to visit all the natural beauties and not only that Menorca offers.
There is a natural wildlife reserve nearby, and there is a beautiful horse riding facility nearby for horseback riding in the Camin de Cavalls trails that cross the island.

Playas de Fornells (Platges de Fornells) is a self contained designer holiday village which is relatively quiet as non residents do not tend to visit the area. There is a small rock beach next to the apartment (jelly / water shoes recommended) and a gorgeous natural beach at the end of the bay ( Cala Tirant ) which is very safe for families and clear waters make snorkeling a must!
There is also a pool near Okapi Bar that you can use, it is a 7 to 10 minute walk.
Be prepared to totally chill out here, this is NOT a party place.
The villages are set in collections on the hill sides overlooking the bay with communal pools and gardens.
Shops, bars and restaurants on site give easy options to eat in or out, and are only a short walk away. There are also several supermarkets in walking distance.

neighborhood_overview:
Its location among large cliffs, its blue water and white sand make Cala en Porter one of the most fascinating coves in Menorca.
Due to its location, Cala en Porter is one of the cleanest and quietest coves in Menorca. It has a slight slope, and swimming in it is like relaxing in a large pool. It is a highly recommended cove for everyone.
On the cliff you will find the COVA D'EN XEROI, a natural cave with terraces that enjoy stunning ocean views. Despite its nightlife, it can also be visited during the day. It's one of the best places to watch the sunset.
Cala en Porter is a starting point for the best kayak routes in Menorca where you can explore different sea caves.
In the residential development, all kinds of services are available. There is no shortage of places to eat such as bars, pizzerias, restaurants.
There is also a nice children's park in the central square and several hiking trails in the surrounding area.

name: Can Maia
description:
Designer house with large garden, recently restored.
It has 3 double bedrooms, two bathrooms, a living room, a kitchen, a covered porch, and a terrace with sofas to enjoy the sunsets.
It is just a few meters from the cliffs of Cala Morell, and very close to the cove itself, where you can swim and dive in the sea. In addition, one of the stages of the Cami de Cavalls starts there, an ideal area for walking or cycling. It is a very quiet and safe area, surrounded by nature.
neighborhood_overview:
Cala Morell is a paradise, tranquility, sea, cliffs, nature and sunsets. It has a small sandy beach and comfortable platforms for sunbathing. The seabed of this cove is half sand, half rocky and stands out for the cleanliness of its waters. From the cliffs surrounding the cove, even at a certain height, you can clearly see the seabed.
At one end of the cove, there is an underwater cave in the rocks, which is a source of fresh water, which can be accessed by diving.
In the valley that ends on the beach, there is a remarkable set of prehistoric caves, dug into the ravine: the Talayotic necropolis of Cala Morell.
In addition, one of the wildest parts of Menorca starts from there, the Cami de Cavalls (horse trail) towards Fornells, ideal for trekking.

neighborhood_overview:
Located 7 km from Ciutadella , Cala Morell with its unmistakable white house style and extensive pine forest, is an area of great landscape value. It is the limit of a natural area of special interest that covers LA VALL, characterized by beautiful virgin beaches and fine sands. The beauty of the area is immense and the tranquility that produces its expansive views relaxes the senses.
Located in the Cala Morell ravine and with privileged views over the bay we find the Talayotic necropolis, a remarkable set of prehistoric caves. Its location is unparalleled, so your visit, with free access, is a must.
The beach, with very transparent waters, ideal for the practice of diving and scuba diving due to its spectacular seafloor, is known for its unique platforms to enjoy the sun baths.

description:

neighborhood_overview:
Binibèquer is a small fishing village located about 8 kilometers south of Maó, in the municipality of Sant Lluis.

The fishing village of Binibèquer was built in 1972 and, being one of the most tourist places on the island, is completely restored. Its narrow streets and whitewashed houses (which look like they came out of a postcard) form a labyrinth in which you will want to lose yourself for a while.

Although at first Binibèquer gives the impression of being a theme park, the houses are inhabited and you have to keep quiet as a sign of respect.

name: Es Blau: Cosy villa in the south of Menorca
description:
Fully renovated villa set in a quiet area. We love its feeling of simplicity in harmony with the easygoing life-style of the island. Everything is at hand while you "unplug" and relax in your private corner.
As you can see from the pictures, the main living area shares kitchen, dining and sitting room extended in the sunroom. A small corridor gives way to the bathroom and three bedrooms.
The villa has been renovated in Menorquin style: all white and with built-in furniture —a home full of light.
neighborhood_overview:
We rent this villa, across the street from ours, because we love the area : quiet and near to a white sandy beach where we can practice our hobbies, snorkelling and kayaking, and because it's a stopover in the Camí de Cavalls trail, a 185 kilometre dirt trail that circles the entire coast of Menorca —we are between stages 16 & 17.

A 10' walk takes you down to the main plaza, with all the basic services such as doctor, pharmacy, restaurants, bars, rent-a-cars....
And 15' away, the child-friendly white sandy beach awaits you, with shallow water a long way out and with facilities such as lifeguards, toilets, sun lounge, sunshade and kayak rental... And a couple of outdoor terrace bars and a big free parking space close by.
We have to mention, though, the steep hill on the way back since we are at the top of the cliffs that surround the sheltered cove.

The Villa stands in a privileged position with uninterrupted views over the entrance to Mahon's magnificent harbor.
Located on the outskirts of the village of Es Castell with many local shops, bars and even a weekly gypsy market. There are two well-frequented restaurants within a five minute walk of the villa and many more within a further ten minutes.

name: Quiet villa in the Port of Addaia
description:
Detached villa with air conditionning and private pool on the north coast of Menorca, in the port of Addaia.
Very quiet place, Addaia is only residencial, no hotels or touristic resorts.
Beaches , marina, scuba diving, kayak, car rentals, bars restaurants, supermarkets close to the house.

The region is exceptionally beautiful. The house is located behind a natural park, with rural and maritime landscapes.
neighborhood_overview:
The neighborhood is very quiet, named Addaia or Port of Addaia, which is integrated into the rural and marine landscape. Just 2 minutes walk from a path named "Camí de Cavalls" away, which literally means "the way of the horse". This path surrounds the island and served in the past as a direct access to the many defense towers of the island.

There are two lighthouses nearby. You can easily reach one of them on foot, by going on the mentioned road.

The nearest beaches are: Na Macaret and Arenal d'en Castell, snatched both a 5-minute drive from the villa. Other beaches are Son Parc (10 minutes by car / bus), Cala Tirant (14 minutes by car / bus), Cavalleria (20 minutes), etc.

There are a few bars and restaurants, a supermarket and a diving center. In the port of Addaia different activities are offered: kayak rental, getting up, boat trips, sailing boats, catamarans, bicycle rental, etc.

A nice way to enter the Cala, having walked from La Gardenia, is to take the few steps down to the boardwalk and walk around the harbour edge to the main area of activity.

“Vista Del Mar” (Sea View) at “La Sabina”, Coves Noves, Menorca.

We bought "Vista del Mar" in 2000.

The apartment is equally suitable for couples and families. 

I speak English and some French, my wife speaks French, English and Spanish.

neighborhood_overview:
Arenal d'en Castell is situated on the northern coast and the town curves around the outstanding horseshoe shaped bay and is within an easy bus ride of other towns to visit.

The bay is as close to a near perfect horseshoe as you can get. The headlands on the waters' horizon close in so much so that you think you might be standing by a large saltwater lake. The eastern end of the resort and beach is more naturally intact with wooded areas and sand dunes.

Rated in the top 5 best resort beaches on Menorca, especially for smaller children due to it's perfect sands and gently sloping shallows into crystal clear turquoise waters. And while this makes it very popular for children it's big enough for those who prefer to avoid the little ones to find their ideal spots! Sun lounger, umbrella, pedalo, kayak hire is available on the beach.

A wooden boardwalk runs from the from eastern end to beach cafe-bars - so ideal for strolls ( Wheelchairs possible too )

name: Casa a 5 minutos de la playa en Binibeca, Menorca
description:
Very comfortable house just a 5 minute walk from Binibeca beach and 200 meters from a wide selection of shops, restaurants and cafes in the popular Binibeca Vell complex. An ideal home for families for a great vacation.
Villa Maricel has 4 double rooms (2 with 2 single beds and 2 with double bed, one of them with en-suite bathroom).

neighborhood_overview:
The fishing village of Binibeca was built in 1972 and, being one of the most touristic places on the island, is completely restored. Its narrow streets and whitewashed houses (which look like taken from a postcard) form a labyrinth in which you will want to get lost for a while.

Although Binibeca initially feels like a theme park, it is a village like any other, and even if it may seem different, its peculiar houses are inhabited.

To get to Binibeca, the easiest option is to go to San Luis from Mahón and from there follow the signs to Binibeca (Binibequer). To get to the fishing village you must take the entrance to Binibequer Vell.

neighborhood_overview:
Our hotel is located on Carrer Menor, a historic street that is part of the original medieval town of Alaior.
The town of Alaior was created after the Catalan-Aragonese conquest of Menorca by the king Alfons in the 13th century. In 1301 the existence of the parish of Santa Eulàlia, but it was in 1304 when King Jaume II of Majorca ordered the purchase of the old Islamic farmhouse of Ihalor. In the fourteenth century the town developed around the hill on where the Santa Eulalia church is located, the highest part and with the best views in the area.

Our hotel was one of the first houses built on the hill, very close to the church and other notable historic buildings such as the Town Hall.

name: Disconnection on the seafront
description:
Beautiful house on the edge of a cliff, in a frontline sea location. Situated in the idyllic urbanization of Cala Morell, one of the most picturesque areas of the island, just 10 minutes aways from Ciutadella.
It features a fully equipped kitchen-dining area, open to a living room with access to the garden and a large private pool.
3 double bedrooms, one of them with a double bed and sea views. It has 2 bathrooms, one of which includes a beautiful bathtub overlooking the bay.
neighborhood_overview:
Cala Morell is a small and picturesque cove located on the northwest coast of Menorca, about 5 kilometers from Ciutadella. It is surrounded by cliffs and has crystal-clear waters, making it ideal for swimming and water sports. It is a rather peaceful cove, highly appreciated for its natural beauty as well as its proximity to Ciutadella.

Historically, the area around Cala Morell is of great interest due to the presence of archaeological remains, including several prehistoric tombs from the Talayotic culture, which date back more than 2,000 years.

In summary, Cala Morell is a peaceful cove, surrounded by natural beauty and rich in history, with a direct connection to the island’s earliest civilizations.

neighborhood_overview:
Ciutadella
The historic city of Ciutadella in located at the extreme west coast of Menorca. It used to be the
capital of culture and commerce in Menorca, and although it has not been this for a long while, it is still a very attractive city, with a wonderful heritage and real appeal.

History
Nicknamed Vella I Bella, which translates to the Old and Beautiful, the city was first settled by the
Carthaginians, and since early days has been in competition with Mahon. In 1558 the city was evaded by 15,000 strong Turkish troops and was defended by just a handful of men. The city fell and was devastated, most of the survivors were
taken back to Turkey and sold as slaves.

When the British arrived in 1708 the city ceased to be its capital.

About town
Ciutadella is a very attractive city, with a charming port, and old quarter, which is a delight to explore. There are several good examples of Baroque and Gothic churches in the city.

neighborhood_overview:
Casa Escorxada is located in Santo Tomás, a charming coastal area in the south of Menorca, ideal for those seeking tranquility, sea and good connection with the rest of the island.

Just 150 meters from the villa, you'll find beautiful Santo Tomás beach, known for its crystal clear waters, soft sand, and relaxed atmosphere. Perfect for families and those who want to disconnect by the sea.

The location is strategic, as Santo Tomás is located approximately halfway between Mahón and Ciutadella, allowing you to travel around Menorca comfortably from a central point.

On the same beach there are two beach bars-restaurants where you can eat or drink in front of the sea, without having to travel by car.

Cala Molí is a small cove with a tiny beach nestled among the few houses that are here. The beach faces inland looking towards Cala Moli which is also one of the entry points into Addaia. There is a dock where local residents can leave their small boats used for sailing or recreational fishing along the pristine beaches of the coast. If Addaia is known for its peace and tranquillity, then here is more so. A place where the population is predominantly Menorquin, many families have known each other for generations here, making it a very friendly community. In July and August during the summer holidays, it becomes a bit busier, but the rest of the year, houses tend to be used only at weekends or in good weather spells. If any kind of development has occurred in recent years, this has been further north at Punta d'En Siulet .
The more crowdy Arenal d´en Castell with its spectaculat beach is only within 1,5 km.

name: Summer Apartment in Menorca | Monthly Rental Only
description: Ideal apartment for monthly rental in summer, on the beachfront in Playas de Fornells, Menorca. With partial sea views, two double bedrooms, air conditioning, bathroom with shower, equipped kitchen, washing machine, living room with TV and balcony. Quiet, family-friendly, landscaped community with pool and solarium. WiFi with fiber optics and alarm. Protected natural environment, close to beaches, restaurants, Es Mercadal, Ciutadella, Mahón and supermarkets.
neighborhood_overview:
Fornells beaches are located on the north coast of Menorca, within the municipality of Es Mercadal. It is a privileged natural environment, with coves and beaches with crystal-clear waters such as Cala Tirant, ideal for swimming and water sports such as kayaking, sailing or windsurfing.

Very close is the picturesque village of Fornells, a traditional fishing port with white houses, restaurants specializing in lobster stew and a family and peaceful atmosphere. Monuments such as the Church of Sant Antoni Abad and the Tower of Fornells, built in 1801 as a coastal defense, stand out.

Fornells Bay is the second largest on the island, about 4 km long and perfectly protected, making it the perfect setting for both quiet life by the sea and water activities.

This environment combines nature, heritage and gastronomy in a relaxed climate, ideal for those looking to enjoy a quiet and authentic summer in Menorca.

neighborhood_overview:
Villa Luciana is located in Son Bou, a small tourist area on the south coast of Menorca. 200 meters away is the longest beach on the island with shallow waters and fine white sand.


The water is crystal clear and transparent, with a turquoise blue color that invites you to swim and enjoy the sun. The bottom of the beach is sandy and soft, making it ideal for families with children and for water sports.


There are several restaurants and bars along the beach that offer a variety of dishes and drinks. There are also several companies that rent equipment for water sports such as paddle surfing, kayaking, or water biking.


Behind Son Bou beach is the Prat de Son Bou nature reserve, which includes dunes, marshes, and numerous bird species.


Very close by are also the early Christian ruins of the Basilica of Son Bou. To the east, inside is the Torre d'en Galmés, an ancient settlement known for its stone towers or talayots.

Son Bou is located on the south coast of Menorca, about 20 minutes drive from the airport and it has the longest beach on the island.

Water sports, a variety of restaurants and the long sandy beach with turquoise water, which is also part of the popular Cami de Cavalls, await you in Son Bou.
The beautiful town of Alaior is a 10-minute drive and offers many more amenities and lots of entertainment in the evenings.
